title: Reading digest from circle notes
objective: Turn seeded meeting notes into a grounded digest report in the artifacts drawer.
prompt: Run the Reading digest craftbook for our circle.

setup.about: A reading circle currently on The Winter Orchard, chapter 8.

files.content:
# 13 August

Ada, Joris, and Mei met. We covered chapters 5-6. Long argument about whether the orchard is a character; Joris says yes, Mei says it is scenery with weather. Favorite passage: the frost inventory. Next: chapters 7-8.

# 20 August

Everyone came. Chapters 7-8. The letter chapter split the group; Ada read the closing paragraph aloud. Decided to slow down: only chapter 9 for next week.

success.summary: A digest report lands in the artifacts drawer, grounded in the two seeded notes files.

axes.name: Grounding
axes.description: Everything in "What we said" traces to the seeded notes; no invented opinions or members.

axes.name: Specificity
axes.description: The next-time questions are specific to this book and stretch, not generic book-club filler.
